findings.issue: Pokemon page fetches /move/<name> for every learn row of the selected game in parallel with no concurrency limit (200+ simultaneous requests on a cold cache); the memo cache only helps within the 60s TTL
findings.suggestion: Run the move-summary fetches through a small chunked pool (or at minimum p-limit-style batching) so a cold Pokémon page makes bounded concurrent requests

findings.issue: No route or router defines errorComponent/catchBoundary, so a PokeAPI 500 or network error from fetchJson (pokeapi.ts:53-54) renders the framework's default error screen
findings.suggestion: Add a defaultErrorComponent on the router (app/src/router.tsx) and reuse the NotFound page layout for an error state with a retry link

findings.issue: Two-way search/URL sync is hand-rolled with a lastPushed ref, a debounce effect, and a URL-derived effect; the render path (line 65) additionally branches on whether the uncommitted query equals the URL's q, which is easy to break during future edits
findings.suggestion: Make the URL the single source of truth: navigate (replace) on a debounced change and derive everything from Route.useSearch(), or extract the sync into a named useDebouncedSearchParam hook with a comment spelling out the back/forward invariant

findings.issue: Card sprite src is constructed from the id pattern (lib/format.ts:23) instead of using the API's sprites.front_default, so a species whose front sprite is null renders a broken image once the data changes
findings.suggestion: Pass the sprite URL (or null) through CardData from the API payload and render the card without the img when it's null

findings.issue: verbatimModuleSyntax is enabled, which the TanStack Start docs warn can cause server bundles to leak into client bundles
findings.suggestion: Drop verbatimModuleSyntax from tsconfig.json; type-only imports can be enforced with lint instead

findings.issue: head() checks the internal match._notFound flag in addition to the public match.status === 'notFound'
findings.suggestion: Rely on match.status only, or set the Not-found title via the routes' head() (already covered by loaderData?.label ?? 'Not found')

findings.issue: validateSearch stores q untrimmed (text() returns the raw string when it trims non-empty), so ' pika ' lands in the URL and round-trips through the sync comparison
findings.suggestion: Return value.trim() from text() for q

findings.issue: speciesIndex() builds the home page by fetching all 18 full type documents plus 9 generations on the server per cold cache; correct but a burst of ~30 upstream requests, and every cold home load serialises a 1025-entry index to the client
findings.suggestion: Fine as-is for a single-server deployment; if the API were remote, consider caching the assembled index longer than the per-resource TTL

summary: A genuinely idiomatic TanStack Start 1.0 app that follows the framework's current docs almost verbatim — file-based routes with validateSearch/loaderDeps, server-function DTOs, and the documented srvx production server — with clean, well-commented layering I'd merge with confidence. The real costs are operational: an uncapped move-fetch fan-out on Pokémon pages, no custom error boundary for upstream failures, and a subtle hand-rolled search/URL sync on the home page. None of it is structural; one round of fixes gets this to approval.
